proposals.title: Proposal 4 – Shareholder Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent, including initiating any topic for written consent.

proposals.title: Proposal 6 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding a Report on Respecting Workforce Civil Liberties
proposals.proponent: The Bahnsen Family Trust dated July 14, 2003
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a civil rights and non-discrimination report evaluating how policies affect employees based on religion or political views and related business risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote against the shareholder proposals based on the reasons set forth in the Company's statements in opposition.
